desc: Parse N, M, and the M precolored cells; collect black and white cell lists and all column coordinates for compression.
Coordinate-compress columns (unioned set of columns from both B and W cells).
First pass (top-down): sort B by row asc, W by row asc; sweep B, adding W with row ≤ current B.row into a BIT, then query BIT for any column ≤ current B.col. If exists, print No and exit.
Second pass (bottom-up): sort B by row desc, W by row desc; sweep W, adding B with row ≥ current W.row into a BIT, then query BIT for any column ≥ current W.col. If exists, print No and exit.
If both passes complete without conflict, print Yes.
